scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter client build && pnpm --filter server build
scripts.db:up: dotenv -e .env.dbmate -- docker compose run --rm dbmate up
scripts.db:status: dotenv -e .env.dbmate -- docker compose run --rm dbmate status
scripts.db:new: dotenv -e .env.dbmate -- docker compose run --rm dbmate new
scripts.db:up:production: dotenv -e .env.dbmate.production -- docker compose run --rm --no-deps dbmate up
scripts.db:status:production: dotenv -e .env.dbmate.production -- docker compose run --rm --no-deps dbmate status
